column2: Lilmoth Dock is a short walk north-north-east of here. The village of Flaa Heet is a longer walk south-west. The walled part of Lilmoth is further still, west-north-west.
These dead trees stand along the shore, south-west of the dock. Wild leeks grow between them.
Three dead Dunmer lie unburied at the east end of the dock. They are a man and two women. It is a little further north-north-east than the dock itself.
I unloaded the small boats at that dock. I drank my wages once too often, and now I sit here and watch it.
